# DocOps

> DocOps is a documentation engineering web application that demonstrates
> docs-as-code architecture, documentation governance, automated documentation
> health checks, API documentation, OpenAPI validation, and CI/CD.

DocOps explores how documentation can be designed, operated, validated, and
maintained as an engineering system. The project also demonstrates approaches
for making technical documentation useful to both people and AI systems.

## Documentation

- [Docs as Code](https://hollyabrams.github.io/docops/docs-as-code): Documentation architecture, source control, review, and publishing workflows.
- [Standards](https://hollyabrams.github.io/docops/standards): Documentation standards and conventions used across DocOps.
- [Operations](https://hollyabrams.github.io/docops/operations): Processes for maintaining documentation over time.
- [Governance](https://hollyabrams.github.io/docops/governance): Ownership, review, standards, and documentation lifecycle practices.
- [Developer Docs](https://hollyabrams.github.io/docops/developer-docs): Practices for API documentation, code examples, and developer-facing technical content.
- [AI](https://hollyabrams.github.io/docops/ai): Approaches to AI-ready documentation, AI discoverability, and AI-assisted documentation workflows.

## Technical resources

- [API Reference](https://hollyabrams.github.io/docops/api): API contract, request and response documentation, and examples.
- [Documentation Health](https://hollyabrams.github.io/docops/health): Automated checks that evaluate the health of the documentation system.

## Additional resources

- [Blog](https://hollyabrams.github.io/docops/blog): Articles about documentation engineering and the development of DocOps.
- [Sitemap](https://hollyabrams.github.io/docops/sitemap.xml): Inventory of published DocOps pages.
